When developing Android or Ionic apps inside WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux), you might hit this frustrating error: [ERROR] Error while getting native targets for android: No valid Android SDK root found.
This usually happens when running: npm run dev:android ionic cap run android ionic cordova run android
